name: kawhitrade
caption:
5 PICKS FOR A 35-YEAR-OLD 🎮🏀 Was it worth it?

• Sept 14, 2026: Kawhi Leonard comes back to us. Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick and five draft picks go to the Clippers (two firsts, two seconds and a pick swap)
• Ingram gave us 21.5 a night last season. He hasn't played yet this year (Achilles)
• Kawhi: 2 of our first 12 games, 19.5 a night in those two
• Gradey in LA: 47.6% from deep through 11 games

Worth it? 👇

facts.claim: September 14, 2026 (Sept 14): Raptors acquire Kawhi Leonard from the Clippers; to Los Angeles Clippers: Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, 2027 first-round pick swap right, 2030 TOR second-round pick, 2031 TOR first-round pick, 2033 TOR first-round pick, 2033 TOR second-round pick (five (5) draft picks: two (2) firsts, two seconds, one swap)

On September 14, Dick was traded to the Los Angeles Clippers alongside Brandon Ingram, and five draft picks in exchange for Kawhi Leonard.
